hook:
Press a button.

kicker: M5Stack Core, three buttons, built-in speaker

roles.m5stack-core: Draws three keys and plays a note per button

igCaption: The M5Stack Core turns its three front buttons into a tiny piano. Hold A, B or C and the matching key lights orange on the LCD while the speaker plays C4, E4 or G4. No wiring, just the board and M5Unified.
ytTitle: M5Stack Core button piano: three keys on one board #shorts
ytDescription: The three front buttons of the M5Stack Core play C4, E4 and G4 on the built-in speaker, and the LCD lights the key you are holding. It runs entirely on the board with M5Unified, no extra parts. Open it in your browser: https://velxio.dev/example/m5stack-core-piano
